## Winter '27 Agentforce, as corroborated (reported 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-23)
- **Marketing Goals Agent** — user defines a **goal, BUDGET and eligible audience**; the agent
  generates a recommended strategy for review and approval; once activated it "operates
  **AUTONOMOUSLY within those guardrails, continuously optimizing** activities and decisions toward
  the desired outcome."  => the approval boundary is ONE-TIME; the budget is the only real bound on
  autonomous commercial action; the eligible audience is a STANDING data-scope grant.
- **Agentforce Content Agent** — creates campaign content at scale while maintaining brand
  consistency. (The second of the two new marketing agents; named on 08-23.)
- **Agentforce observability** — refined agent analytics and **CUSTOM SCORERS**, some in Beta.
- Also: agent interoperability, voice, multilingual conversations, improved agent management.
